_comment: Fixture for backend/tests/test_clustering_integration.py and docs/phase2/clustering.md's live threshold sweep. Deliberately built to exercise: (1) one real-world event covered by 4 outlets with differently worded headlines, including one EMAIL newsletter and three RSS pieces, so the cross-source dedup case (ADR-003 / PRD F-08) is covered by the same cluster; (2) two RSS items that share a lot of surface vocabulary ('launches', 'test flight', 'reaches orbit successfully') but describe genuinely distinct events and must NOT merge; (3) 19 unrelated singletons spanning EMAIL and RSS so real clustering runs have negative space to fail into.

items.title: TechCorp to acquire DataFlow for $2.3 billion in largest AI deal this year
items.body: TechCorp announced Tuesday it will acquire data infrastructure startup DataFlow for $2.3 billion in cash and stock, the largest acquisition in the AI sector this year. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter pending regulatory approval. DataFlow's pipeline tooling will be folded into TechCorp's cloud platform.
items.author: Reuters Staff

items.title: The DataFlow Acquisition and What It Means for the Bundle
items.body: TechCorp's purchase of DataFlow this week is best understood as a bundling move, not an infrastructure move. The $2.3 billion price tag is high for a company DataFlow's size, but the strategic logic is about owning the pipeline layer before a competitor does. This is the aggregation pattern playing out again, one layer down the stack.
items.author: Ben Thompson

items.title: TechCorp buys DataFlow: notes on distribution
items.body: A quick note on TechCorp buying DataFlow for $2.3bn. The interesting question isn't the price, it's distribution: DataFlow's pipelines are already embedded in thousands of enterprise data stacks, and that install base is what TechCorp is really paying for, not the technology itself.
items.author: Benedict Evans

items.title: TechCorp just bought DataFlow. Here's why it matters
items.body: TechCorp's $2.3 billion acquisition of DataFlow closed faster than expected regulatory scrutiny would have suggested, and that's a signal in itself: antitrust enforcers are not treating pipeline infrastructure the way they treat consumer platforms. Employees at DataFlow tell Platformer the integration timeline is aggressive, targeting Q4.
items.author: Casey Newton

items.title: SpaceX launches Starship on record tenth test flight, reaches orbit successfully
items.body: SpaceX launched its Starship vehicle on its tenth test flight Wednesday from Starbase, Texas, successfully reaching orbit for the fourth consecutive time. The booster completed a controlled ocean landing. SpaceX said the next flight will attempt a full booster catch at the launch tower.

items.title: Rocket Lab launches Neutron on debut test flight, reaches orbit successfully
items.body: Rocket Lab's new medium-lift Neutron rocket reached orbit successfully on its debut test flight Thursday, launching from Wallops Island, Virginia. The company called it a flawless first flight and confirmed a second Neutron launch is scheduled within the month. Neutron is designed to compete directly with SpaceX's Falcon 9.
